status: Only implemented tutorial archetype: ordinary house spiders in adult and juvenile sizes. Larger spider types remain future content.

presentation.effects: Wet ochre hemolymph and dark residue on spider hits; restrained red contact droplets on player injury. Four pooled emitters and eight reusable floor marks. No supernatural glow.
presentation.effect_cancellation: Pause clears all effects; activation, deactivation and checkpoint retry clear only that enemy's effects. Idle pool processing is disabled. Full pools reuse the oldest slot.
presentation.effect_assets: Original low-polygon droplet meshes, eight pooled floor meshes and synthesized spatial impact audio; no added lights or particle collision.

adult.visual: Recovered large spider scene loaded by main.gd
adult.navigation: Five-room waypoint graph with capsule sweeps, floor probes and live closed-door rejection. Route decisions run at most every 0.35 seconds; static edge results expire after 0.6 seconds. No teleport or wall climbing.
adult.attack_telegraph: Recovered walk/run clips plus rig-specific front-leg, pedipalp and fang posing. Windup locks attack direction; a close stationary bite or a straight lunge has one physics-checked impact, followed by retreat/cooldown.
adult.attack_cues: Original synthesized dry lunge rush, surface contacts and restrained impact transients. Leg contacts are motion-synced; the attack tell uses body and fang posture.
adult.weapon_hurt_volumes: Two pose-following body spheres at recovered rig Root and Back, radii 0.22 m and 0.25 m. Movement capsule remains radius 0.32 m and height 0.64 m; thin legs are not inflated into a body-sized target.
adult.resolution: Escape at existing safe-exit anchor OR kill with weapon damage. 100 HP, zero armor: 25 worn-knife hits at 4 damage without prior damage. Flashlight remains nonlethal and capped at 3 total damage. Death cancels attacks, removes collision, plays a 1.1-second rig pose and unlocks the same exit while leaving a visible corpse.

juvenile.visual: Optimized Literock Giant Spider Lite 1K skinned GLB in the local game package; CC0 Quaternius source-checkout fallback, then code-native visual
juvenile.death_visual: Short procedural collapse; the Literock Lite rig has no death clip
juvenile.weapon_hurt_volumes: Pose-following head sphere radius 0.095 m and abdomen midpoint sphere radius 0.12 m. Movement capsule remains radius 0.13 m and height 0.27 m; Literock forward correction is preserved.
juvenile.attack_telegraph: Authored Bite clip with a committed physics-driven forward dart and body lift. One line-of-sight and range checked impact at 0.28 seconds, then a punishable recovery. Sidestep, jump, doors and knife stagger remain valid counters.
juvenile.spawn: One fightable entry spider after a grace period; two separate approach-triggered supply/nest spiders during exploration; two encounter juveniles join the adult later. Exploration spiders retire for the encounter.
